resources.string: Point this device at your restaurant

This app is a window onto the computer that runs your restaurant. Open the QServe console on that computer, go to Terminals, and point this phone\'s camera at the station\'s code — Android offers to open it here. Or copy the address and paste it below. This device remembers it.
The restaurant computer has to be running QServe, on the same Wi-Fi, with its licence activated. Before activation nothing is served to devices at all.
This device is not on the restaurant\'s Wi-Fi, the main computer is switched off, or the licence has not been activated yet.
Enter the address of the restaurant computer.
